svg.aria-label: How to make a Mamie Taylor, step by step: Combine ingredients. Add the Scotch, lime juice and simple syrup to your shaker. Shake. Add ice and shake hard, until frosty cold. Top with ginger beer. Pour it right into the shaker, and give it a gentle swirl. Pour it all in. Pour everything, ice and all, into a highball glass. The drink is already chilling on that ice. Garnish. A lime wheel on the rim. Cheers!
